title: The Road to Pancake Hill
synopsis: The adult crews finish the neighborhood’s pedestrian approaches, Rex and Molly reunite at Pine Park, and Jack draws where every winter machine worked without confusing the footbridge with a truck road.
continuity_state: Before: Brook Road and Station Lane are plowed, the western icy bend is treated, the farm lane is cleared by Ruth’s tractor, and the Pine Park walkway by Mr. Lee’s snowblower is inspected. Little Bridge is still only for walkers and needs a final adult check/hand clearing before the puppies can cross. After: The adults have shoveled and inspected the Little Bridge and footpaths; it remains a pedestrian bridge without vehicle access. Rex and Molly reunite at Pine Park; all six seasons’ places are unchanged beneath snow. Jack adds an indexed winter route sketch to his existing notebook and the town plow and spreader return to municipal depot; a future thaw is possible but not yet depicted.
